title: Flamingo reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="66" rx="20" ry="14" fill="#ff8fa3"/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="62" rx="14" ry="8" fill="#ffb3c1"/>
  <!-- Wing -->
  <path d="M36 62 Q46 54 58 62 Q52 70 38 70 Z" fill="#ff6f91"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M58 58 Q64 46 62 36 Q60 28 56 24" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Neck light edge -->
  <path d="M58 58 Q64 46 62 36 Q60 28 56 24" stroke="#ffb3c1" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="20" r="9" fill="#ff8fa3"/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="17" r="5" fill="#ffb3c1"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="49" cy="18" r="2" fill="#3d1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="48.5" cy="17.3" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d="M44 23 Q38 26 40 30 Q44 28 47 25 Z" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <!-- Beak tip -->
  <path d="M40 30 Q37 31 38 29 Q39 28 40 30 Z" fill="#3d1a2e"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1="42" y1="79" x2="42" y2="92" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="52" y1="79" x2="52" y2="92" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <path d="M38 92 L42 92 L42 94 L38 94 Z" fill="#ff6f91"/>
  <path d="M48 92 L52 92 L52 94 L48 94 Z" fill="#ff6f91"/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x="62" y="56" width="22" height="16" rx="1.5" fill="#4a90d9"/>
  <!-- Book pages -->
  <rect x="64" y="58" width="9" height="12" fill="#f2f2f2"/>
  <rect x="73" y="58" width="9" height="12" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <!-- Book cover edge -->
  <rect x="62" y="56" width="22" height="16" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="#2d6ab3" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Book spine line -->
  <line x1="73" y1="56" x2="73" y2="72" stroke="#2d6ab3" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Text lines on book -->
  <line x1="66" y1="62" x2="71" y2="62" stroke="#b0b0b0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="65" x2="71" y2="65" stroke="#b0b0b0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="68" x2="70" y2="68" stroke="#b0b0b0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="75" y1="62" x2="80" y2="62" stroke="#a0a0a0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="75" y1="65" x2="80" y2="65" stroke="#a0a0a0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="75" y1="68" x2="79" y2="68" stroke="#a0a0a0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- Wing/arm holding book -->
  <path d="M58 66 Q62 62 66 60" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 66 Q62 62 66 60" stroke="#ffb3c1" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
